name: infer-1.0-galsbi
scope: Core GalSBI-prior continuous-scene shear inference pipeline; each run must separately pin its model, sampler recipe, source, data and seeds.

core.prior: GalSBI F24 continuous target and neighbour scene population; latent target type marginalized
core.integration: Posterior scene sampling with MH and optional likelihood tempering
core.selection: Independent forward-population selection normalization with propagated uncertainty
core.estimator: Selection-corrected score/information solve; bright-only second evaluation in reference mock
core.model_identity: Separate from inference identity; like-1.0-galsbi is the current model fiducial, not the model used for the historical mock result

reference_mock.pairing: Original and 90-degree-rotated partner scenes; same injected shear, independent selection
reference_mock.sampler_recipe: Historical mixed magnitude-dependent chains and score evaluations, including a bright-only second step; see archive/research-2026-11-08/doc/MOCK_MEASUREMENT_REVIEW.md

current_implementation.variant: Later full-proposal-likelihood sampler, not the exact mixed mock recipe

limitations: Single injected shear does not separately identify m1 and c1 or measure m2.
Mock g2 offset is 2.02 sigma, narrowly failing its declared 2-sigma gate.
Some magnitude bands and the 320-row short-chain fallback retain convergence limitations.
No completed end-to-end mock inference result for like-1.0-galsbi or galsbi-multistage.
The finite-catalogue v1.1-infer/v1.2-infer configurations and likelihood defaults are unchanged.
